settings.heading: How it works
settings.content: 1. Design it here and check the live preview and print files. 2. Add one hoodie, or switch to Whole group and add everyone with their own size and name. 3. We print exactly what you approved using durable DTF transfers on premium hoodies.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content: Printed in the UK and dispatched in 5–7 working days. Group orders for a whole year are dispatched together. Personalised items can't be returned unless faulty — if something's not right, we'll reprint it.

settings.heading: Sizes
settings.content: Adult sizes are unisex and roomy — pick your usual size. Kids sizes are by age. Not sure? Order a size up for a relaxed leavers fit.
